q1_issues.issue: The antecedent-less "It" is filled by `sk_it_1` with no class atom at all; an antecedent-less pronoun takes a witness classed by the salient kind or else `thing`, named on the `sk_<class>_<n>` pattern.

The definite plural "the views" is typed `(Member sk_views_1 view)`; a definite plural takes a group witness `(GroupOf sk_views_1 view)` — the instruction set uses "the views" as its own worked example of this.
Neither named party gets its kind atom (`(Member free_soil_party party)`, `(Member republican_party party)`), which is required when the kind word sits inside the name (the "Kestrel River" rule).

notes: The coordinated possessors correctly distribute as two `Possession` atoms over one shared views referent, and `Theme` is the right role for "supported" (the views are unchanged).
